note: Authoritative stage/seat/skill policy for /grill, /plan, /build, /resume, /visibility and uncommanded work/fix. work-entry and fix-entry are internal tokens. Select only applicable runtime-available domain skills; required skills and semantic check owners apply to the specified seat and rigor. Human summaries defer to this table.

responsibility_rules.single_semantic_owner: Every check in `responsibilities.semantic_checks` has exactly one semantic owner. Other seats may verify that the owner returned the required fields, cards and hashes; they never re-execute the same semantic pass.
responsibility_rules.formal_verification: Only the controller runs check.py verify-step / record-human-step (and verify-goal / finish-goal). Implementation seats hand back with formal V pending and never write the ledger.
responsibility_rules.audited_seat: Audited strict implementation never dispatches task-worker. Resolve the seat through seat_selection.audited_implementation: controller or step-executor only.
responsibility_rules.guarded_seat: Guarded substantive implementation dispatches the worker subagent; unavailability follows the Failure Branches disclosure rules.
responsibility_rules.normal_seat: Normal implementation defaults to the controller in-session; dispatch a worker/reviewer when independent judgement, a verification blind spot or the owner asks for it.
responsibility_rules.reviewer_pua: When routing assigns a PUA stage card to a reviewer seat, the reviewer executes that card and returns its result; the controller never repeats the same card.

stages.entry: final brief handoff at the end of /grill

reviewer.scope: the finalizing brief version only; individual interview rounds are not reviewed

stages.domain_skills: select when the brief's acceptance items involve a technology or real boundary with a matching available skill

stages.entry: whole-goal engineering design and executable task handoff in /plan (Normal/Guarded)

reviewer.scope: whole engineering design, shared interface consistency, fully specified later tasks, component/boundary/milestone verification and goal coverage; never demands Audited contract/compiled PLAN/manifest artifacts

stages.ui_acceptance: design actual UI journeys from user workflows; prepare-plan derives applicability from boundary/journey mapping. Read-only feasibility investigation is allowed; product UI actions remain in build.
stages.domain_skills: none expected; select only if the goal's verification itself depends on a specialized capability

stages.entry: per-outcome verify-goal execution (Audited goals, or whenever evidence is missing or suspect)
stages.domain_skills: select when an outcome's verification depends on a specialized capability

stages.entry: Guarded/Audited implementation work packages in /build or internal Fix Mode (Normal may stay in-session or dispatch a worker)
stages.domain_skills: select per work package when the touched technology has a matching available skill; the worker seat loads it without gaining permissions beyond its agent definition

stages.entry: material Guarded/Audited integration milestone acceptance (not every component check), or a Normal change that needs independent judgment or hits a verification blind spot

reviewer.scope: current slice and affected scope; no reconcile/manifest/SI artifacts

stages.ui_acceptance: execute before the handoff: every required scenario covering this slice's affected interface outcomes must be passed (or reasoned not-applicable); controller operates the UI (webapp-testing for web-only journeys, computer-use for native boundaries), reviewer checks the recorded sidecar evidence
stages.domain_skills: select when verifying the slice needs a specialized read-only capability; read-only reviewers request executions via CONTROLLER_ACTION

stages.entry: stable candidate build after implementation, engine verification and planned UI acceptance; before review-verdict acceptance or goal-finish (schema-2/3 goals with product_observation.required)

reviewer.scope: observer returns findings; the existing reviewer judges findings_validity and coverage_adequacy at review-verdict/goal-finish

stages.ui_acceptance: observer holds the exclusive UI lease over the delivered candidate during discover/compare; planned ui-acceptance scenarios stay controller-executed before this stage; packets are generated via workflow_packets.py observer
stages.domain_skills: backend routing per product-observer/references/backend-routing.md; adapters (direct-multimodal/playwright-cli/midscene/ui-tars; media via ffmpeg) only after live probes pass on the host
select per contract boundary (migration, privacy, GUI, ...)
rare; only when the PLAN's own verification depends on one

semantic_checks.note: validate returned manifest fields, author identity binding and hashes; never re-run the semantic card

stages.domain_skills: select when writing the frozen tests requires a specialized capability; test-author's edit boundary unchanged

stages.entry: Audited PLAN step execution and its verify-step gate

reviewer.dispatch: per Audited step: the reviewer audits the step diff; a hard issue blocks complete. Unavailability is disclosed and covered by the blocking converge audit.

semantic_checks.note: run verify-step and validate engine evidence; never a second semantic pass

stages.domain_skills: select per step technology; official V stays controller-owned

stages.entry: Audited slice finish / SI handoff: converge-audit first, then the controller's slice-acceptance card before the owner decision

reviewer.scope: reconcile-bound converge audit of the finished slice; the reviewer executes the review-verdict card; the controller separately executes the slice-acceptance card before the owner decision

stages.ui_acceptance: Audited slices with interface boundaries bind scenario execution to the slice's V/acceptance evidence; owner acceptance of the observed UI journey is never delegated
stages.domain_skills: select per slice boundary; owner acceptance never delegated

stages.entry: whole-goal finish check before finish-goal (all rigor modes)

reviewer.scope: original request/every brief BS, whole goal, deferred work, real user-entry journeys; a clean slice audit never substitutes

stages.ui_acceptance: final recheck: the delivered artifact identity must match the sidecar binding; re-execute scenarios invalidated by late changes; ui-gate must pass before finish-goal under runtime-policy/1
stages.domain_skills: select for the final integrated verification boundary (GUI, browser, data, security, ...)

seat_selection.note: Authoritative Audited implementation-seat table. profile direct -> controller; full -> step-executor; light + autonomous -> controller; light + checkpoints/stepwise -> step-executor. The table in subagent-orchestration.md is the human-readable copy and must agree with this block. Audited strict work never dispatches task-worker.

pua_conditions.unknown-rigor: fail-closed: a missing rigor cannot exempt a guarded-or-audited card

ui_acceptance.capability: webapp-testing for web-only journeys (controller-operated browser automation, assertion-first); computer-use for native desktop/OS-dialog boundaries (desktop MCP)
ui_acceptance.applicability: required whenever an affected outcome includes an interface journey; absence of backend blocks (never not-applicable); no interface in scope requires a recorded applicability: none with reason
ui_acceptance.gate: check.py ui-gate <goal-card> --trace <trace.json> [--bind] enforces scenario statuses, controller computer-use/webapp-testing load, native call references and artifact binding before finish-goal

domain_capabilities.note: Conditional domain skills registered for Skill Applicability Selection. Load only when the trigger matches the actual slice boundary; they are additional capabilities, never a blanket call-everything rule. `insertion` names stage ids or workflow entry points (fix-entry, build-entry) where the capability is evaluated.

capabilities.name: stop-that-shit
capabilities.trigger: extra hardening, possible overengineering, repeated verification loops, explicit task boundaries, scope creep, or direct invocation; ordinary validation, retry, or dependency use alone is not a trigger
outputs: in-scope decision and verification using the original Skill prompt; no additional gate or proof file

capabilities.name: skill-creator
capabilities.trigger: the requested deliverable is a new or revised agent skill, skill description/trigger, or a measured evaluation of skill behavior; not ordinary application development
outputs: original skill artifact and realistic task/trigger evaluation when the host can run it
actual observed results versus a comparable baseline, or an explicit capability gap; no fabricated Claude runs

capabilities.name: architecture-designer
capabilities.trigger: high-level system architecture design or review, or significant architectural decisions about components, patterns, scalability or infrastructure; not routine code-level changes
outputs: verbatim upstream architecture design and trade-offs
ADRs for all significant architecture decisions and actual stakeholder review before finalizing; never fabricate approval

capabilities.name: receiving-code-review
capabilities.trigger: the controller or implementation seat receives actionable human or independent reviewer findings and must decide whether and how to repair them; not a trigger while writing a review
outputs: checked feedback against the current code and approved scope
itemized adoption, technical disagreement, or specific clarification before affected edits

capabilities.name: frontend-design
capabilities.trigger: the goal explicitly creates or reshapes a user-facing visual interface, layout, typography or visual identity; not a routine UI bug fix or UI acceptance run
outputs: brief-grounded design direction and implementation of requested visual outcomes
existing UI acceptance evidence remains controller-owned

capabilities.name: vercel-react-best-practices
capabilities.trigger: actual React or Next.js code is being designed, written, refactored or reviewed and a specific rendering, fetching, bundle or performance rule is relevant; not non-React code or speculative optimization
outputs: applicable upstream rules checked against actual React/Next.js usage and version
verified affected behavior or measured performance, not an unrelated optimization sweep

capabilities.name: security-assurance
capabilities.trigger: authentication, authorization, privacy, secrets, cryptography, untrusted input, multi-tenancy, externally reachable attack surface, regulated data
outputs: threat/abuse model mapped to existing acceptance items
control-to-verification mapping
residual risks for owner decision
SECURITY_HANDOFF bound to artifact identity

capabilities.name: production-readiness
capabilities.trigger: production deployment, long-running service, remote persistent state, data migration, availability objectives, externally operated infrastructure
outputs: release and progressive rollout plan with stop conditions
observability and alert acceptance criteria
rollback/migration rehearsal evidence
post-deploy verification bound to artifact identity

capabilities.name: incident-response
capabilities.trigger: active production impact, outage, data corruption or exposure, security compromise, alert requiring immediate restoration
outputs: severity and incident state
containment and recovery record with timeline
service restoration verification
handoff to internal Fix Mode with failure signature

capabilities.name: outcome-learning
capabilities.trigger: unvalidated user, adoption, workflow-efficiency or business hypothesis; success observable only after real use
outputs: falsifiable outcome hypothesis with baseline
metric and guardrail definitions
smallest ethical experiment design
support/insufficient/refuted conclusion

dispatch_levels.capability-available-mandatory: dispatch whenever the seat exists at runtime; cost is never an exemption. Fallback tiers per subagent-orchestration.md Failure Branches.
dispatch_levels.blocking: Audited independence gates block on unavailability; no controller downgrade.
dispatch_levels.none-for-this-stage: no reviewer dispatch is attached to this stage unit; reviews happen at the acceptance handoffs above

reuse_rules.same_version_single_seat: one reviewer return may cover multiple declared acceptance items for one stable artifact version and scope
reuse_rules.never_cross_scope_or_version: a slice review never substitutes whole-goal review; changed artifacts invalidate prior returns
reuse_rules.cards_are_not_dispatch_units: goal-verification/test-freeze/step-verification cards do not add reviewer dispatches by themselves

seat_requirements.reviewer-subagent: fresh dispatch, read-only, loads reviewer skill; loads pua when pua_stage_id supplied; pua_acceptance required with matching stage_id
seat_requirements.worker-subagent: loads task-worker skill; one writer at a time; Guarded substantive work only
seat_requirements.test-author-subagent: fresh dispatch, loads test-author skill, edit limited to tests/manifest
seat_requirements.step-executor-subagent: fresh dispatch per Audited seat-selection table; loads step-executor skill
